title: Initial Project Setup Generator
description: Initialize your first application in the NextFeature workspace. Sets up Next.js structure, TypeScript path aliases, TailwindCSS configuration, and environment setup. Typically run immediately after plugin initialization.

name.description: Name of the application (e.g., web, admin, dashboard). Creates apps/[name]/ with full Next.js project structure and TypeScript path alias @app/[name]
name.x-prompt: What name would you like to use for this application?

directory.description: Override the directory where the application will be created (default: apps/ creates apps/[name]/)

skipFeature.description: Skip creating the feature library structure within the application
